name: no-new-scan-time-deps
body: The structural scanner introduces no scan-time dependency: it is a self-contained Rust binary that never shells out and needs nothing on `PATH`. Its build-time dependency is only a current stable Rust toolchain plus crates.io. Acceptance: a scan of a repository containing shell/YAML/TOML/JSON/XML/Dockerfile/Makefile/INI files with none of their toolchains installed still emits their `File` nodes and structure.
